questions.question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

The supervisor / wanted to known / the pros and cons / of the issue.
questions.solution:
The error is in "**wanted to known**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• '**Wanted to known**' is grammatically incorrect.
 
• The correct usage is '**know**' instead of '**known**'.
 
• **To know** = the infinitive form
 
• **known **= the past participle form
 
• Examples-
 
 
• I know her name.
 
• I have known her for a long time.
 
 
 
• The correct sentence: *The supervisor wanted to **know **the pros and cons of the issue.*
 
• Hence, the correct answer is **option 3**.

questions.question:

Sholay __is one in the most popular__ Hindi movies.

options.text: is one in the more popular
is one of the most popular

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'is one of the most popular'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct phrase which will replace the given phrase is- "is one of the most popular"
 
• *The subject of the sentence is 'Sholay' and it is a proper noun hence, the singular verb is used. We use the phrase 'One of the' when we need to select the one thing from the many things i.e. why the noun written after the preposition is always in the plural form because we are selecting the one thing/person from the many things/persons.*
 
• Let's see an example-
 
 
• **One of the students** who are studying is sitting at the table.
 
 

**Hence, the correct sentence is-** *Sholay is** one of the most popular** Hindi movies.*
